# Perch

> A native Mac utility for agent activity and sticky notes at the edge of your screen.

Perch is standalone software for macOS 14 and later, built with SwiftUI and AppKit.
Price: $29 USD, one time, for the first 1,000 customers, then $99. Plus applicable taxes. Includes a year of updates and email support; full refund within 14 days. App license only; source code is not included.
Status: Purchases are closed until delivery is ready. No payment is currently collected.

## Integration limitations
Claude Code CLI and Cursor local Agent activity have been checked live, and Codex CLI answering was checked live; the Codex desktop app is not verified yet. Cursor passive hooks do not expose awaiting-permission status. Answering is opt-in and off by default: for Claude Code, Perch can allow or deny tools, answer questions, approve or revise plans, and reply when a turn ends; Codex supports allow, deny and replies; Cursor supports a reply when a turn finishes. Every answer has a two-second undo, and Perch never answers on its own.
